commonProcedure:
WARD5-COMMON-149. This is static authored operational review of these five identities only. Preserve the complete native catalog record, original questions, school placements, class rows and historical metadata beside the new procedure. An Instantaneous source field remains in that evidence; a finite maintained ward lifetime below is an expressly NEW resolution, not recovered canon. No extra school access, generic upcast, class acquisition, feat, sourceStatus migration or canonical catalog/index write follows.

All five keep Action, V/S/F, native rank 8, base 21 RP and minimum class level 15. Use the actual casting class's ability, repertoire/preparation, school and additional costs: Cleric and Druid use Wisdom; Mage and Wizard use Intelligence, subject only to an actual sourced substitution. Spell attacks are d20 + PB + that modifier, and spell DC is 8 + PB + that modifier plus only genuinely acquired applicable source bonuses. None of these five admissions adds a save merely to use that DC. Antilife Shell has Cleric/Druid/Wizard routes only; the other four also have Mage. Perceive the recipient or chosen center, meet the native range and caster line of effect, have a usable somatic hand and actual focus, and be able to perform verbal components. A known absent legal target, inaccessible mode or unavailable action fails before payment. Private eligibility resolves after legal commitment, without a free diagnosis or refund. No save is added to these five NEW admission procedures. Recipient wards require actual willingness; an unconscious creature cannot newly consent. Previously established protection does not require continued consciousness.

Use the bound ordinary casting contract: determine final price from pre-cast Dissonance, then commit costs, Action, components and any concentration transition; update the actual class's first-family/base Dissonance and same-name Refrain exactly once at beginning; open legal cast-time counters; surviving payload resolves afterward. A countered or suppressed paid cast retains costs, cadence and displaced concentration. Readying pays/starts concentration at preparation and releases through the actual Reaction/trigger before its original deadline, without a second payment, cast or counter window. A required concentration spell uses the one real slot and ends on actual loss, incapacitation or source death. No ward receives a free extra action, start, recovery, rest, resource pool or hard-control allowance.

Each application has a unique cast/application ID, original source character/class/school/rank, recipient or fixed center, creation timestamp, original deadline, concentration owner if any, and actual suppression and termination causes. Half-open lifetimes [establishment,deadline): expiry wins at the deadline. Clocks continue through suppression, absence, reorder and scene transitions. Explicit elapsed-second lifetimes below override generic round conversion. Recasts are real new paid casts. For each recipient-ward identity, NEW at most one established application per recipient across casters/modes: a genuinely established eligible replacement ends the previous same-identity ward; a failed/countered/suppressed-before-establishment cast replaces nothing. Ordinary concentration displacement is independent. Separate fixed area casts have independent original identities; no stacked force, damage or clock reset. There is no new voluntary area dismissal permission; ending concentration where required follows the accepted interface. NEW a willing recipient may end its own Alignment Immunity or Mind Blank without an Action during its actual regular turn; it cannot waive one protected component while retaining the same ward. Ended wards do not restart without a new cast.

Newly prevented components create no dormant application, owed damage or guard claim. Suppression of a previously established eligible expression preserves its source record, original clock, used control guard, spent costs/actions and original damage roots. Resume only a still-live expression, with then-current lawful prerequisites and no missed ticks, commands, saves, healing, temporary-HP refill or repeated initial consequence. Existing consequences are not retroactively undone; a currently resumed Incapacitated component does end any genuinely new incompatible concentration, without refunding or repeating historical losses. Source ending while suppressed remains terminal. Actual positive damage, CON concentration saves and source-sensitive endings still use their own rules. These ward entry rules are not whole-Action denial and spend no hard-control guard.

Keep public observation separate from director-only predicates. A stopped body or unavailable information can be observed normally; no exact hidden alignment, score, membership, immunity cause, creature type or remote location is automatically published. Unresolved authoritative facts are explicit whole-case/branch holds, never fabricated successful campaign examples. A hidden fact that an actual authoritative campaign ledger possesses can be resolved privately; an auditor lacking that ledger cannot certify its positive case. Current index/receipts supersede old preparation labels calling already-applied cohorts pending; preserve those labels as historical evidence only. All inherited source/content/access/physical/cosmology/runtime holds remain; no whole-domain, runtime, human-play, balance or release approval is made.
procedure:
RW149-R. KEEP Action/120feet/V/S/F/rank8/base21 and the negative-reputation threshold. NEW one fixed 20-foot-RADIUS spherical ward volume anchored at a perceived point on actual immobile solid support within120feet and caster line of effect, maximum3,600 elapsed seconds, no concentration. All boundary surfaces are included where center line of effect exists; actual solid total cover clips the magical boundary, and the ordinary solid obstruction remains real. No stone fortress, air/sound/light/line-of-effect barrier, pressure, indefinite city protection or mobile source is created. Positive-volume body crossing, not token center, determines entry; exterior tangent contact is allowed. Radius/lifetime/anchor are explicitly new, not source measurements.

NEW select exactly one actual canonical faction ID at commitment for which the caster has both established current membership and actual invocation authority. This uses neither positive standing nor temporary affiliation as a membership substitute; multiple qualifying memberships permit one selection, never a union. The source's faction records, draft/resonance/private flags and jurisdiction survive unchanged. A known missing permission/membership blocks preflight; a hidden disqualifier discovered at resolution yields paid nonestablishment without diagnostic publication. Actual later confirmed loss of the caster's qualifying membership or invocation authority ends this ward; no automatic restart after reacquisition. Death does not by itself invent institutional expulsion, and nonconcentration duration is otherwise independent of caster consciousness. Missing authoritative membership/permission is a whole-positive-case hold. A synthetic conditional trace is not evidence that any campaign character belongs to a faction.

NEW at each proposed outside-to-inside crossing, test THAT body's actual current mechanically interpreted standing with the selected institution. Negative is strictly less than0 (-3,-2,-1), not nonpositive;0,+1,+2,+3 are eligible. Membership of the entrant is not required. For a genuinely known subject and exact known faction under an evidenced standing-v1 policy, an uninitialized absent pair has the established default derived view0; preserve raw absence, do not write a fabricated0. Null, false, strings, unknown keys, ambiguous duplicates, unversioned magnitudes and unknown subjects/institutions are unresolved, never silently normalized. Retain EX58 raw envelope/version/interpretation/provenance and genuine scene caps. The current private ledger may resolve a hidden score without telling either actor its number; when the authoritative ledger itself is missing, keep the attempted outcome held, not guessed. Disguise, hostility, alignment, orders from a disliked owner and apparent profession are not standing.

NEW body-only exclusion (RW8-R03 A) gives 'impenetrable to those' a complete finite movement meaning. Negative bodies cannot enter voluntarily, by forced movement, carriage or a voluntary teleport whose destination enters/intersects the protected interior; paid teleport failure leaves its indivisible payload at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel has no imaginary beam. Every carried living or nonliving CREATURE body is checked by its own actual standing; ordinary gear is not a creature. An eligible carrier cannot bring an ineligible body through as luggage. Without a separately legal release the actual inseparable group stops before the boundary. A separately neutral companion is not guilty by association and can enter; its actual command remains governed by its own source and budgets. A negative entrant's living limb/natural-body reach cannot cross, but a nonliving weapon projection with legal reach, released projectile, remotely originated spell, air/light/sound and independent objects are not barred by THIS body-only rule. Other defenses still apply. No ward damage or Action denial is added.

NEW fully inside negative occupants at establishment may remain and leave; an initially negative body straddling an operative boundary prevents establishment after legal payment. An inside score change to negative does not eject, crush or relocate the body. Exit is permitted monotonically; once wholly outside, current standing gates reentry. A body straddling a restored boundary, or becoming negative/growing there, causes NEW whole-ward ending before restoration rather than cutting it or making a permanent hole. Fully inside bodies after suppression remain safe and may exit. Actual unavoidable Falling or support motion that would create an illegal negative-body straddle ends this ward before crossing, preserving the same fall/motion; it is no platform. Ordinary stoppable forced entry stops legally. Recast checks actual current occupancy and never resets institution history.

NEW real standing changes are processed by their real source, not by entry attempts. Preserve the original scene opening score, signed scene delta cap±2, standing bounds±3, unique cause IDs and nonbankable overflow. Reputation Shield prevents qualifying new negative signed contributions only while operative; it does not make an existing -1 nonnegative, erase historical acts, veto repairs/deduplication or freeze a cast-time floor. Positive changes and source-authorized corrections still occur. A negative change during Shield suppression remains real after resumption; no deferred prevention/refund. Fortress reads the resulting current interpretation at its next genuine boundary checkpoint, with no moral judgment, score reveal, free institutional access or consequence cancellation. BAN-CLOSE-03 mandatory terminal return retains only its own established endpoint exception and physical-placement rules.
